*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: build.zig
@@
 pub fn build(b: *std.Build) void {
-    // Production builds always use ReleaseSafe (see AGENTS.md).
-    const optimize: OptimizeMode = .ReleaseSafe;
+    // Production builds always use ReleaseFast for maximum runtime performance (see AGENTS.md).
+    const optimize: OptimizeMode = .ReleaseFast;
@@
             .root_source_file = b.path("src/lex.zig"),
             .target = host,
-            // Debug build for tests to surface issues (extra safety checks,
-            // better diagnostics) earlier than the ReleaseSafe production build.
+            // Debug builds retain safety checks and diagnostics that the
+            // performance-focused ReleaseFast production build omits.
             .optimize = .Debug,
             // Zig 0.16.0's fuzz test runner does not compile with Debug error tracing enabled.
             .error_tracing = false,
*** Update File: README.md
@@
 ```
-zig build-obj -target aarch64-macos.26.0 -O ReleaseSafe src/lex.zig -femit-bin=liblex.o \
+zig build-obj -target aarch64-macos.26.0 -O ReleaseFast src/lex.zig -femit-bin=liblex.o \
     && xcrun libtool -static -o liblex.a liblex.o
 ```
*** Update File: AGENTS.md
@@
-- On production build, always use `ReleaseSafe`.
+- On production build, always use `ReleaseFast` for maximum runtime performance.
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: playground/ios-app/build.zig
@@
 pub fn build(b: *std.Build) void {
-    // Production builds always use ReleaseSafe (see repo AGENTS.md).
-    const optimize: OptimizeMode = .ReleaseSafe;
+    // Production builds always use ReleaseFast for maximum runtime performance (see AGENTS.md).
+    const optimize: OptimizeMode = .ReleaseFast;
@@
-    // Strip debug info from the iOS slices. This keeps ReleaseSafe's runtime
-    // safety checks but lets the compiler dead-code-eliminate Zig's panic
-    // stack-trace symbolizer (std.debug.writeCurrentStackTrace). That symbolizer
-    // references the dyld SPI `_dyld_get_image_header_containing_address`, which
-    // the iOS SDK refuses to link against, so an unstripped slice fails to link
-    // into the keyboard extension. On panic the engine still aborts; it just
-    // prints "debug info stripped" instead of a symbolicated trace.
+    // Strip debug info from the ReleaseFast iOS slices so the compiler can
+    // dead-code-eliminate Zig's panic stack-trace symbolizer
+    // (std.debug.writeCurrentStackTrace). That symbolizer references the dyld
+    // SPI `_dyld_get_image_header_containing_address`, which the iOS SDK refuses
+    // to link against, so an unstripped slice fails to link into the keyboard
+    // extension. An explicit panic still aborts without a symbolicated trace.
*** Update File: playground/ios-app/README.md
@@
-- **Stripped slices.** The iOS slices are built `ReleaseSafe` but with
-  `strip = true`. This keeps the runtime safety checks while dead-code-removing
-  Zig's panic stack-trace symbolizer, which references the dyld SPI
+- **Stripped slices.** The iOS slices are built `ReleaseFast` with
+  `strip = true` to maximize runtime performance and dead-code-remove Zig's
+  panic stack-trace symbolizer, which references the dyld SPI
   `_dyld_get_image_header_containing_address` that the iOS SDK refuses to link
-  against (an unstripped slice fails to link into the extension). On a panic the
-  engine still aborts; it just cannot print a symbolicated trace.
+  against (an unstripped slice fails to link into the extension). `ReleaseFast`
+  omits runtime safety checks; an explicit panic still aborts without a
+  symbolicated trace.
*** End Patch
